# AI art with a fast local model

**Idea Dice** designs the game and writes one image prompt per asset. **Z-Image Turbo** (8 steps, ~2 s per image on a 16 GB GPU) draws them, **Remove Background** cuts them out and **Sprite From Image** turns them into crisp pixel sprites.

Missing models? ComfyUI offers to download them when you open this workflow (Z-Image Turbo ~20 GB total, BiRefNet ~0.9 GB). Any image model works: replace the sampler chain with SDXL / Flux / your favourite.
